idea-plugin.name: ML Experiment Cockpit
idea-plugin.description:
Browse your MLflow experiments, runs and metrics directly inside your JetBrains IDE — no browser, no notebook, no extra code.

  • Your MLflow tree, one click away — experiments, runs, status and parameters inside a tool window, refreshed with a single button.
  • Metrics, charted instantly — pick a metric and read its history as a curve, with the last value and the step it was recorded at.
  • Works in the IDE you already use — PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, GoLand, CLion; your MLflow tracking server stays where it is, nothing is sent anywhere else.

Three more tabs cover the rest of an ML workflow: Optuna (studies and trials from an Optuna Dashboard), Models (the MLflow Model Registry) and Sweeps (W&B sweeps, read-only, with a W&B API key).

What you see is the server’s answer, within its query limits: up to 500 experiments, 100 runs per experiment, 500 registered models, 500 model versions and 5 000 metric points per run. W&B sweeps are read without pagination (the first 50 sweeps).

Open it from the ML Experiment Cockpit tool window and configure your servers in Settings | Tools | ML Experiment Cockpit. Every request goes to the servers you configure — the plugin sends nothing anywhere else.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.18 — Run tooltips now show.

  • The tooltip of a run in the Experiments tree is now displayed when you hover it: Swing only shows a renderer's tooltip for a component registered with the ToolTipManager, so the run details were silently never shown. This fix was not part of the 0.0.17 build.

0.0.17 — Compatible with the 2026.3 IDE release, and clearer W&B errors.

  • The plugin now declares compatibility up to IDE build 263.*, so it keeps installing on PyCharm 2026.3 instead of becoming obsolete when that release becomes stable.
  • W&B tab: a GraphQL error now shows the server's own message (e.g. "Cannot query field …") instead of a bare "GraphQL error", and an unknown project is reported as "project not found" instead of an empty list.
  • The MLflow and Optuna tabs are unchanged.
